name: Hedgewars
description: In the retrieved Hedgewars checkout, the macOS Sparkle bundle configuration uses the HTTPS Hedgewars appcast and names the bundled dsa_pub.pem as SUPublicDSAKeyFile. The Qt front end invokes the macOS Sparkle checker only when its auto-update preference is enabled. Other platform packaging and Sparkle framework enforcement remain outside this review.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification; released artifacts, framework enforcement, and complete Windows/Linux packaging paths were not independently audited.
